verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents configurable alerts that notify a devops lead by chat or email when observability conditions are met, such as deploy failures, error spikes or bandwidth thresholds. The closest items are form-entry notifications (netlify-docs-28), which are a different feature, and a community mention of a 'GitHub/Slack integration' that does not describe condition-based alerting. Neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
